BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced on May 14, 2026, that it purchased 1,707,504 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc, as part of its share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026. The highest price paid per share was 860.4000 pence, the lowest was 845.8000 pence, and the volume-weighted average price paid was 852.7450 pence. Sage intends to cancel all purchased shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 14 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
